summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path helper; exported it from monai/data/__init__.py; added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities block; and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests, each cleaning up its temp directory). Tests and black/flake8 were not run, per instructions; line lengths were measured to be within 120 columns. Judgment calls: labels are resolved only when present in segmentation mode, a missing image yields a ValueError via the resolver, a non-list key value and a non-dict top level raise ValueError, and an RST tilde heading was not checked against existing heading levels. Nothing was committed.
